segments.sn56.23:1.4: Dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ –
segments.sn56.23:1.6: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisambuddhattā tathāgato ‘arahaṃ sammāsambuddho’ti vuccati.
segments.sn56.23:2.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.
